text:
Incident Bot: PAGER: P1 - inference 5xx spike in eu-west-1 for /v1/generate. Current error rate ~18% over last 3m. War room: https://redwood.inc/warroom/4182468100 — join ASAP
Carla (on-call): acked. Joining war room now. paging @Raj (SRE) and @Marta — please confirm customer impact triage.
Raj (SRE): I’m on it, pulling live logs and metrics. Suspect KV cache pressure + recent model variant rollout. Attaching logs shortly.
Marta (Product): Noted. Initial customer-impact: some Enterprise customers on EU region seeing failed generation and timeouts; UX shows 500s. I’ll draft status page copy.
Kevin (CS): I’ll start a targeted notification for customers with active SLA tickets in EU and flag to account reps. Need a short template — send me the final line.
Ops Scribe: Capturing: incident id INC-4182468100. War room link posted. Carla owner. Raj assigned as tech lead. Marta on customer comms. Kevin on direct outreach.
Carla (on-call): Pager ack :white_check_mark: — if Raj needs code rollbacks or capacity changes, I can approve bursts on Dedicated pool.
Raj (SRE): Quick findings: tail latency + eviction spikes on kvcache, many cold prefix misses. Also seeing high memory allocs from model variant v2.3. Runbook step: try reverting to v2.2 for the main-prod routing.
Raj (SRE): Plan: 1) disable v2.3 routing (canary -> immediate rollback) 2) scale dedicated GPU pool by +2 nodes for eu-west-1 3) throttle non-critical batchers for 10m. Executing step 1 now.
Carla (on-call): Executing rollback command per runbook — will paste confirmation.
Carla (on-call): ```bash
# rollback canary routing
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/admin/route/rollback -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","from":"v2.3","to":"v2.2"}'
```
Carla (on-call): Rollback request accepted by control plane, propagating. Estimated 60-90s to take effect.
Incident Bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/4182468100 — state: investigating. (automated update)
Raj (SRE): Seeing error rate drop in the next metric window — 5xx down to ~6% and counting. Starting capacity scale now.
Marta (Product): Draft status page blurb:
"We're investigating increased 5xx errors for inference requests in eu-west-1. Affected calls may see failures or delays. Engineers are rolling back a recent model variant and scaling capacity. No data exposure is suspected. We'll post updates every 15 minutes or on significant milestones."
Kevin (CS): Customer email template (short):
"Hi {{name}}, we’re investigating elevated errors in our EU inference region affecting some generation calls. Engineers are mitigating and we expect reduced failures shortly. We’ll update you within 30 minutes or sooner. — Redwood Inference Support"
Ops Scribe: Note — created internal incident channel #inc-4182468100 for audit and threads. Recording timelines and runbook steps.
Carla (on-call): Confirming: rollback completed and capacity +2 nodes requested. Monitoring for stabilization for 15m. If error rate >5% after 15m, escalate to oncall-2 @Divya and trigger DR plan.
Raj (SRE): Metrics look stable, tail latency improving. I’ll keep monitoring and start a short postmortem draft once stable.
Marta (Product): I’ll push the status page blurb and send a hold-for-update customer note to Kevin to review.
Kevin (CS): Sending to affected accounts now. Will post copy in the war room and @mentions reps.
Incident Bot: Reminder: next automated status update will post in 15 minutes.
Carla (on-call): Great work team — keeping the war room open for 30m after stabilization then handing back to oncall rotation. Ops Scribe, capture any follow-ups for postmortem (model rollout gating, KVCACHE alerts, canary threshold).
Ops Scribe: Will capture items and assign owners in the postmortem doc. Closing immediate incident actions when stabilization window finishes.
